scope: Pass 15 follow-up 4.29.7; source-stat decisions for the baseline missing quest encounters. Inputs, never generated catalog edits.
search_order: Darkan combatdefs and bestiary, rev-742 client identities for admitted variants, independent game-main definitions, pinned pre-cutoff wiki metadata. Cache identities cannot supply hidden stats.
failure_cases: Wrong NPC variant or cross-quest match
Incomplete or calibrated emulator stats treated as period evidence
Lost provenance or changed saved encounter IDs
Review action uses statless fallback instead of sourced fight

followup_review.scope: Distinguish missing source stats from parser or variant-selection defects; recheck hitpoint-only encounters against literal pre-cutoff and pre-beta histories.
followup_review.wiki_queries: curl -A AnkiScape parity audit; literal title history without modern redirects; nearest revision before 2012-11-20 and, for hitpoint-only encounters, before 2012-06-01.
followup_review.negative_search_controls: Ram period metadata is recovered; nested infobox traversal and explicit hidden-level detection are covered by behavior tests. Darkan/game-main both recover the level-6 Giant rat core stats.
failure_cases: Current redirects can replace historical combat pages with noncombat articles
Nested infobox tabs can hide variant records
A variant label is not a scalar stat value
An alias fix does not independently corroborate an emulator stat block
